name: memory
summary: Agents on all your machines share what they learn through your own private memory repo.
day: A trap one agent hits on your laptop is a note the next agent reads on your devbox, minutes later.
cost: A small private GitHub repo, and a sync every five minutes.
risk: Agents write notes about you and your work into the memory repo. Keep it private.

settings.question: Which private GitHub repo holds your agent memory, such as you/agent-notes?

workflows.name: Shared memory
workflows.sentence: Agents on every machine read and write one private memory repo, which syncs every five minutes.

moment.title: It remembers
moment.body: An agent on your devbox already knows the trap another agent hit on your laptop this morning, because both read the same memory.
